answer: The violet counter is kept in ocean and raven shows each reset. Someone as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 14 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 14 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 2338 identities would post 3232 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
